docs.title: Very Cool Cursed Walking Server
docs.text:
▪ DAY — ▪ THE DEAD STILL WALK ▪ LAST BROADCAST --:-- UTC ▪

Cracked Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge server running a heavily optimized version of the Cursed Walking modpack — same content, but with the ambience, shader, and graphics-enhancement mods stripped out so it runs on modest hardware. Currently in testing — open from time to time. New here? Start with Install, then check the Rules.

docs.title: Server at a Glance
docs.text:
• Type

    Minecraft 1.20.1 on Forge, running the Cursed Walking modpack. Testing phase — schedule varies.

  • Access

    Online-Mode: OFF — cracked clients are supported.

  • Built for lower-end systems

    Our copy of the pack has ambience, shader, and other graphics-enhancement mods removed. Around 60 FPS on 4 GB RAM on typical machines.

  • What to expect

    Thirst, hunger, infection. Firearms and melee. Hordes at night. PvP outside safe zones. See the full mod list on the Install page.

docs.title: Who runs the server?
docs.text:
The server is owned and operated by Auzer1 and FunOD — the same two people running the anarchy and cobblemon servers.

If someone claims 'staff powers' in-game

They are attempting to deceive you. No hidden or alt staff accounts exist.

docs.title: Is there an official Discord?
docs.text:
No. There is no official Discord server, and there are no plans to create one. Many player-run communities exist, but none of them are moderated or sanctioned by us. We do not participate in — or take responsibility for — any external community drama.

For direct contact, see the Support page.

docs.title: Why is your version of Cursed Walking different from the CurseForge one?
docs.text:
We removed the ambience mods, shader mods, and other graphics-enhancement mods from the pack. The game content — weapons, zombies, thirst, infection, structures, all the interesting mechanics — is intact. What's gone is the visual bloat that makes the official pack unplayable on lower-end hardware.

The point is inclusivity: anyone with a modest laptop should be able to play here. We measure success in "does it run at 60 FPS on 8 GB RAM," not "does it have the prettiest fog."

docs.title: Is this a cracked server?
docs.text: Yes. Online-mode is off. Any launcher that can connect to an offline-mode server works — see the Install page for the specific recommendations.

docs.title: Is cheating or exploiting allowed?
docs.text: Exploiting isn't punishable, but is automatically prevented by the AntiCheat. Any exploits that bypass the AntiCheat aren't punishable either.

docs.title: Are there plans to increase the player limit?
docs.text: Not at the moment. We prefer to keep the server manageable and within a resource range we can personally oversee. The current sweet spot is a 50–100 player range.

docs.title: Are you interested in expanding advertising?
docs.text: No. We prefer organic growth. The server's direction is dictated by our personal preferences and the current hardware workload — not by a desire for a massive player count.

docs.title: Which version are you running?
docs.text: The live Required mods list on the install page always reflects the exact mod set the server is running. If your client matches that list, you're good.

docs.title: Will you switch to a newer version of the base pack?
docs.text: When there's a stable release we've had time to test. Version bumps get announced on the news page a few days ahead so you have time to sync your client.

docs.title: Can I use OptiFine?
docs.text: No. It crashes with the rendering stack in Cursed Walking. Do not install it.

docs.title: Can I add my own mods client-side?
docs.text: Cosmetic mods (Sodium alternatives, shaders you install yourself, cosmetic HUD tweaks, minimap replacements, keybind managers) — yes, welcome. Anything that adds content, changes recipes, or modifies world generation — no, it'll get rejected by the server's mod check.

docs.title: How much RAM does my machine need?
docs.text: Allocate at least 4 GB to the instance. Less than 4 GB and you'll stutter through chunk loads.

docs.title: What launchers are supported?
docs.text: Any launcher that can install Forge 1.20.1 and connect to a cracked/offline-mode server works. Popular choices among players include the CurseForge App, Prism Launcher, TLauncher, ATLauncher, and SKLauncher.

docs.title: How do I claim land / stop people breaking into my base?
docs.text: Land protection is enabled — check /help in-game for the current commands (they change between pack versions). Don't leave valuables in unclaimed chunks.

docs.title: Still have a question?
docs.text: Head to the Support page to reach an admin.

docs.title: Install
docs.text:
Cursed Walking on this server is not the same pack you'd install from CurseForge. We stripped out ambience mods, shader mods, and other graphics-heavy content so the pack runs on modest hardware — most players see around 60 FPS on 4 GB RAM. Content stays intact; visual bloat doesn't. Because of this, installing the official CurseForge modpack will not let you join — you'll get rejected on the connection mod check.

The four setup paths below give you our modified pack instead. Pick whichever fits how you already play.

Two things that will break your install

  1. Do not install OptiFine. It crashes with the shader/rendering stack that ships in Cursed Walking. Even though we've removed most graphics mods, the ones that remain still conflict with OptiFine.
  2. The server runs Minecraft 1.20.1 on Forge. Wrong version, wrong loader (NeoForge/Fabric), or missing mods → rejected at connect.

docs.title: Pick your install path
docs.text:
Preloaded modpackAutoModpackStandardFully manual

Easiest — everything set up already. A pre-configured Forge 1.20.1 instance with AutoModpack, our modified mod list, and any needed configs already inside. Import into your launcher and launch.

Download link not currently available

The preloaded pack is offered when we have a working build to share. Use the AutoModpack or Standard tab in the meantime — both get you to the same place.

When available, the flow is:

  1. Download the preloaded modpack zip from the link posted here.
  2. In your launcher: Add instance → Import from zip and select the file.
  3. Give it at least 4 GB of RAM.
  4. Launch and add the server (address on the home page).

Recommended for most players. Install AutoModpack once, and it syncs the mods from the server on every launch. Version bumps happen automatically — you don't touch the mods folder yourself.

  1. In your launcher, create a Forge 1.20.1 instance. See Launchers we recommend below if you don't already have one set up.
  2. Allocate at least 4 GB of RAM to the instance.
  3. Download AutoModpack for Forge 1.20.1 from Modrinth or CurseForge.
  4. Drop the .jar into your instance's mods/ folder.
  5. Launch the instance. When you first connect to the server, AutoModpack will download the rest of the mod list into a subfolder and prompt you to restart.
  6. Restart, connect again — you're in.

Any client-side-only mods you add (Sodium-alternatives, cosmetic HUDs, keybind managers) can live alongside AutoModpack's synced mods without issue.

Import the modpack into your launcher containing the forge version/loader, AutoModpack mod & server list. This is currently the fastest path to enter the server: Download Modpack

  1. Download the preloaded modpack zip from the link posted here.
  2. In your launcher: Add instance → Import from zip and select the file.
  3. Give it at least 4 GB of RAM.
  4. Launch and add the server (address on the home page).

No launcher at all. Straight Minecraft + Forge installer + manual mods. For portable setups, unusual OSes, or when you want to know every file that landed on disk.

  1. Install Java 17 (Adoptium/Temurin recommended).
  2. Grab the Forge 1.20.1 installer from the Forge downloads page — pick the recommended build for 1.20.1.
  3. Run the installer → Install client into a fresh game directory.
  4. In that directory, create a mods/ folder. Download every mod from Required mods into it.
  5. Point your Minecraft launcher (vanilla, or whatever) at the Forge 1.20.1 profile and launch.
  6. Connect to the server.

This is the most work. Use it only when the other tabs don't apply.

docs.title: Launchers we recommend
docs.text:
Any launcher that can install Forge 1.20.1 and connect to a cracked / offline-mode server will work. Popular choices among players:

  • CurseForge App — free, imports Forge instances easily, supports offline mode.
  • Prism Launcher — open source, actively maintained, cracked-friendly.
  • TLauncher — well-known among cracked players; has built-in Forge install.
  • ATLauncher — supports Forge and offline mode.
  • SKLauncher — lightweight, cracked-friendly.

If you're brand new to modded Minecraft, the CurseForge App or Prism Launcher are the two smoothest choices.

docs.title: Required mods
docs.text:
Every mod currently on the server, pulled live from the actual mods/ folder on the box. Sync happens every five minutes.

Client-side mods are welcome

You can add any client-side-only mod on top of this list — cosmetic HUDs, keybind managers, minimap replacements, and so on. Only mods that add content, change recipes, or affect the world will get you rejected by the server's mod check.

docs.title: Resource packs
docs.text:
The pack ships with what it needs bundled in. You should not need to install anything extra to connect. If we ever add a server-side pack, it'll show up here.

docs.title: Verify your install
docs.text:
Run through these before your first connection attempt. Most first-time issues fall out of exactly one of them.

  • Minecraft version reads 1.20.1.
  • Loader reads Forge (not NeoForge, not Fabric).
  • Allocated at least 4 GB of RAM to the instance.
  • Every mod in the list above is present in your mods/ folder — or AutoModpack has synced them.
  • OptiFine is not installed anywhere in the mods folder.
  • You logged in with any Minecraft profile — cracked accounts are fine.

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
Game crashes on launch with a shader or rendering error

OptiFine is almost certainly in your mods folder. Remove it. The pack already includes what it needs for shaders — no third-party additions needed.

??? question '"Connection refused" or "Server not responding"' Check the home page — the server status card shows if the box is down. This modpack is in testing and the server runs on a schedule, not 24/7. If the card says online and you still can't connect: double-check the address for typos, verify the mod list matches, and try a fresh launcher restart.

??? question '"Missing mods" or "Mod rejections" on connect' Your mods folder doesn't match the server's list. Either sync via AutoModpack, or diff your folder against the live Required mods list above and add whatever's missing.

Extreme lag or slow chunk loading

Give the instance more memory — 4 GB is safe on most machines. If you're on integrated graphics, expect low framerates during horde events; nothing we can do about that server-side.

Java version errors

Cursed Walking on 1.20.1 needs Java 17. The CurseForge app and Prism handle this automatically. For manual installs, install Adoptium/Temurin 17 and point your launcher at it.

AutoModpack refuses to download

Make sure your AutoModpack version is for Forge, not Fabric or NeoForge. Also verify the instance actually reached the server once — AutoModpack only knows what to fetch after a successful handshake.

I tried everything and it still won't work

Head over to Support — bring your latest crash log. Without it we're guessing.

docs.title: Rules & Core Principles
docs.text:
The server runs on a small set of principles rather than a long rule list. If you understand these five, you understand how the server works — and how disputes get resolved.

The one hard boundary

Ideological views, dark humor, and heated arguments are tolerated. Targeted harassment is not. Slurs, threats, or sustained pile-ons directed at a specific person or group cross the line — everywhere else is fair game.

docs.title: 1. Radical Freedom
docs.text:
• PvP, building, and raiding are allowed everywhere.
  • No safe zones. No protected territories. No claim system.
  • If you don't want to lose it, don't leave it unattended.

docs.title: 2. Ideological Tolerance
docs.text:
• Extreme political and ideological views are permitted in global chat.
  • Hard boundary: no targeting groups or individuals with slurs, threats, or sustained harassment.

docs.title: 3. Death & Consequences
docs.text:
• Inventory drops fully on death — standard vanilla behavior.
  • Griefing, theft, and betrayal are legal. Trust is earned, not granted.

docs.title: 4. Absolute Independence
docs.text:
• The server has no official Discord, no official guilds, and no "partnered" communities.
  • Any group claiming to represent server administration is unofficial and unaffiliated.

docs.title: 5. Verified Authority
docs.text:
• Only two people have administrative power: Auzer1 and FunOD.
  • Anyone else claiming to be a moderator, "helper," or staff is lying.
  • We do not run hidden or alt staff accounts for moderation.

docs.title: Conflict Resolution
docs.text:
How disputes are actually handled when they escalate:

Situation Handling In-game conflict, chat drama, PvP grudges Chat/world isolation is the primary tool Evidence of off-server attacks (DMs, forums, doxxing attempts) Permanent cross-platform ban Impersonation of staff Immediate ban Reports without evidence Not actioned

docs.title: What Is Not a Rule
docs.text:
To save everyone time, these things are allowed and are not going to be actioned:

  • Killing other players, anywhere, for any reason
  • Building near, on top of, or inside another player's base
  • Stealing, scamming in trades, betraying alliances
  • Trash-talking in chat within the hard-boundary limits above
  • Using client-side mods that pass the AntiCheat (see FAQ)

If you're looking for a protected, moderated experience, this is not the right server for you — and that's fine.

docs.title: Recovery
docs.text:
If you've lost your progress or forgotten your server login password, you can contact an admin directly.

Click to reveal contact

Discord: @auzer

Please mention that your issue is with the Cursed Walking server specifically (there are a lot of Auzers out there, and we run more than one server).

docs.title: Reporting an Issue
docs.text:
Before reaching out, check whether your issue is covered on one of these pages:

  • Rules — for questions about what is and isn't allowed.
  • FAQ — for common questions about server operation and the modpack.
  • Install — for setup, launcher, and mod-list problems.
  • News — for downtime notices, updates, and known issues.

If none of those cover it, contact an admin using the spoiler above.

What we cannot help with

  • Player disputes (see Rules)
  • Recovering items lost inside unclaimed chunks — claim your land
  • Issues with third-party launchers or your local Minecraft installation
  • The official CurseForge version of Cursed Walking — our modified pack is what runs here; see Install
